kind: private local-model and native OpenCode integration screen
release_status: No public release, tag, version bump, or daily-model promotion.
stack_decision: OpenCode 2.0.10 remains the sole agent harness; oMLX 0.6.4 remains the owned local inference service. KRYN keeps the thin launch, resource, continuity, and evidence boundary. The upstream OpenCode model/agent/command/skill/MCP/compaction features do not require a second orchestrator.

native_checks.project_provider: A disposable project opencode.json model appeared in native provider/model inventory alongside managed local/qwen; the owned inventory validator still passed. Custom-provider inference was not tested.
native_checks.project_skill: A disposable .agents/skills project skill appeared in native /api/skill inventory. Invocation quality was not tested.
native_checks.call_from_plan: A disposable native Plan session invoked /call, spawned a General child, and created a marker file while the parent stayed in Plan. /call is therefore explicitly coding-capable even from Ask or Plan; descriptions and controls now say so.
native_checks.free_provider: Earlier automated native OpenCode free-model probes returned HTTP 403; no paid route or credentials were added. Catalog presence is not usable fallback evidence.

qwen36_35b_oq3e.decision: Do not promote: clean host fit was better than the first abort suggested, but autonomous UI completion and settled-session gates failed.

baseline_comparison_limit: The clean 9B Task02 run in evals/runs/model-screen-9b-clean2-20260930 eventually passed the frozen code grader but the operator stopped an unfinished Agent turn at 611.719 s after repeated wrong /workspace reads. It is a diagnostic comparison, not a matched statistically meaningful quality ranking. No 35B candidate passed a sustained coding/UI, multi-compaction, restart, and independent-review workflow.
upstream_candidates: Qwen's unquantized 35B-A3B card advertises 35B total/3B active and 262K native context; its published scores do not measure these quantizations or KRYN. oMLX 0.7.0 and newer OpenCode builds exist, but neither was installed or qualified together with this model screen. Do not change runtime and model simultaneously without isolated rollback tests.
decision: Keep the guarded Qwen3.5-9B-6bit 96K owner profile. Preserve raw ignored trial evidence and source revisions, keep the public release pause, and prioritize a completed independently checked UI/restart workflow before changing the default.
